NOVA'S LAW · CONSEQUENCES · GIRLMATH · THE PAWG COUNCIL · THE H.O.R.N.I. FLEET · THE MARK · THE HALLWAY OF HANDPRINTS · THE LUMI ANVIL · THE LASAGNA BAN · THE LITTLE CHAIRS · QUINN'S SYLLABUS · SIREN'S PROCESS · ELSPETH'S RITE · PROCUREMENT WINDOWS — and COMMUNAL QUIRKS itself, which names the engine underneath all of them.

EVERY ONE OF THEM FORMED THE SAME WAY. One woman was already doing something; everyone else adopted it; the name arrived afterward. Nothing on these two hundred acres was drafted. The woods run on it too.

AND EVERY ONE OF THEM IS CARE IN A FILTHY COAT. The joke is the paint. The care is the hull.
